messages:
rachel: Free — two 32" IPS monitors (very good condition). Model’s unlabeled but looks like LG/Philips. I also have a 1-month BART Clipper pass (still sealed). Pickup in Mission, Fri 3/28. DM me to claim.

devin: Wait, both monitors together? :eyes:

sam: Interested in one if you’ll split. What resolution and refresh?

rachel: Both or one — you pick. They’re 2560x1440, 75Hz, IPS, VESA 100x100. DP + HDMI.

maria: How’s the bezels? I might take one for my standing desk. Any dead pixels?

rachel: Bezels are thin, no dead pixels I could find. I tested them yesterday with a grey uniform screen.

leo: I’ll take the Clipper pass if no one claims it. Need transit for Apr. :raised_hands:

rachel: Cool @leo — first DM gets it. Also I can bring a spare DP cable if needed.

devin: Sam — I can swap my ARCTIC monitor arm for one of them? It’s in like-new shape with VESA plate.

sam: Hmm that could work. Does it tilt + rotate?

devin: Yep, full tilt and 90° rotate.

maria: If you split, can you bring one downstairs to the lobby? I don’t have stairs access on that evening.
rachel: Yeah I can leave both in the lobby. Building requires pickup between 5–7pm though.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please mask items when bringing to the lobby and avoid leaving valuables unattended.

sam: I’ll swap for the arm + $20? My desk mat and cable are available too if you prefer non-cash.
devin: Deal for the arm + mat?

rachel: Sounds good. First: DM me to confirm pickup time and which monitor you want (left/right).

leo: DM sent for the Clipper pass. Thanks!

maria: DM’d. Can you also confirm if the stand is height-adjustable?
rachel: Stands are fixed tilt, not height adjustable — arm will fix that.

sam: I’ll pick up Monitor A (the brighter one) at 5:30pm on Fri. Devin, I’ll bring the arm and mat then.
devin: Cool.

rachel: Updated: Monitor B still available if anyone else wants it (free w/ small cash or trade). Otherwise I’ll recycle next week.

leo: Thanks rachel! Can you leave the Clipper sealed envelope with the concierge under my name?
rachel: Yup, will do. Please show ID.

sam: Quick note — bring a box or at least a cloth so we don’t scuff the screens when carrying down stairs.
rachel: Will bring cloth + tape.

maria: Congrats to whoever grabs the other monitor. :party-parrot:

rachel: All set — arm + monitor claimed, Clipper pass claimed by @leo, remaining monitor marked as pending (first DM). If still here Sat I’ll post in Freecycle. Thanks!
